name: Pantau Pangan
description: Visualisasi harga pangan strategis nasional — bubble chart interaktif real-time

narrative.strategy: Restrained — tinted neutrals + Padi Green accent ≤10%. Signal colors are data vocabulary, not brand palette.
narrative.elevationStyle: Layered: tonal surfaces for depth, ambient glow for the logo, heavy float shadow for tooltips and modals.
narrative.componentFeel: Approachable & clear. Geist Sans throughout. Pill shapes only for filters; gentle curves elsewhere.

padi-green.role: brand accent — logo, glow, primary active state

motion.reducedMotionFallback: instant transition (0ms) on all animated properties

components.name: Button — Primary
components.description: Primary action button. Used for the most important action on a surface.

components.name: Button — Outline
components.description: Secondary action button. Used for secondary or cancel actions.

components.name: Timeframe Filter Pills
components.description: Pill group for selecting chart timeframe. Container is a glass capsule with backdrop blur.

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Pill-shaped search input with expand animation on focus. Backdrop blur glass treatment.

components.name: Bubble Tooltip
components.description: Hover tooltip for a price bubble. Shows commodity name, price, change %, and optional sparkline. Glass treatment with heavy float shadow.
components.html:

components.name: Data Footer
components.description: Bottom status strip. Shows data freshness and time range. Full-width glass strip.
components.html: Data terbaru 18 Jun 2026 Akumulasi sejak 14 Jun 2026

components.name: Bubble Chart Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder for the bubble chart. 21 SVG circles with pulse animation.

components.name: Brand Logo Mark
components.description: The 'P' logo mark with Padi Green glow. The only element where decorative shadow is allowed.
